policy: Protocols are declared plans, not verified execution. Files and mappings do not establish claim support or resolve reviewer concerns.

research_questions.title: Quality under Matched Budgets
research_questions.question: How does CTLS answer accuracy compare against hybrid and BM25 across all three token budgets on the stratified LongMemEval-S subset?

research_questions.title: Mechanism Attribution via Tier Partition
research_questions.question: Does the tier partition eliminate the temporal dominance condition by construction, and does removing decay entirely (hybrid_no_time) serve as an ablation upper bound?

research_questions.title: Lifecycle Cost under Memory Reuse
research_questions.question: How does write-plus-query cost change when a single constructed memory bank serves multiple distinct queries, and does CTLS change that cost?

experiments.title: CTLS versus Hybrid and BM25 at 512 Tokens

budget.scope: Complete memory section including the identical wrapper.
budget.packing: Identical whole-item packing in all arms; CTLS drains tier-0 first.

dataset.name: LongMemEval-S full history subset
dataset.adaptation: Full history source retained. QA is a balanced subset with a substituted Qwen judge.

scoring.method: Pinned original LongMemEval task-specific prompts; arm-blind strict yes/no parsing; primary qwen3-max-2026-01-23.
scoring.review: 966 distinct responses audited; 239 model disagreements have member-5 boolean decisions.

statistics.unit: Memory episode, averaging repeats within memory
statistics.method: Stratified memory-cluster bootstrap; paired cluster sign-flip test; Holm correction.

limitations: CTLS is evaluated on the same frozen bank as hybrid and BM25; no new model calls are required.
The non-dominance property holds by construction; empirical results measure whether tier-0 candidates are consistently more useful than tier-1 candidates.
Three temperature-zero calls measure operational repeatability, not variation across model families.
Blinded primary/secondary judge audit requires human adjudication before final paper submission.
A frozen read-only single-layer bank is evaluated; the legacy 20-item L1 capacity is not asserted to support full histories.
This is a LongMemEval-S subset with disclosed deviations, not an official leaderboard score.

budget.scope: Complete memory section including the identical wrapper.

dataset.name: LongMemEval-S full history subset

statistics.unit: Memory episode, averaging repeats within memory
statistics.method: Stratified memory-cluster bootstrap; paired cluster sign-flip test; Holm correction.

limitations: CTLS non-dominance is a structural property of the scoring rule, not a measured empirical claim.

experiments.title: CTLS Robustness at 2048 Tokens

budget.scope: Complete memory section including the identical wrapper.
budget.packing: Identical whole-item packing in all arms.

dataset.name: LongMemEval-S full history subset
dataset.adaptation: Full history source retained. Same 84-question subset at higher budget.

scoring.method: Pinned original LongMemEval task-specific prompts; primary qwen3-max-2026-01-23.

statistics.unit: Memory episode, averaging repeats within memory
statistics.method: Stratified memory-cluster bootstrap; paired cluster sign-flip test; Holm correction.

limitations: At 2048 tokens, nearly all tier-0 items fit within the budget, reducing the practical impact of tier partition; this budget tests whether CTLS retains the gain when budget is not a binding constraint.
protocol_replication is the same 84-question subset at a higher budget, not an independent cohort.

experiments.title: Measured Memory Reuse on Synthetic Banks

dataset.name: Synthetic entity/value variants
dataset.adaptation: Eight synthetic banks; each serves twenty distinct queries after one construction.

scoring.method: Pinned LongMemEval task-specific prompts; primary qwen3-max-2026-01-23.

statistics.unit: Memory episode, averaging repeats within memory

reuse.construction_cost_policy: Count construction once per memory instance; per-query cost = (write + sum of query costs) / query count.

limitations: Synthetic banks share templates; eight entity/value variants do not establish generality on natural workloads.
The linked pair provides the endpoint after twenty queries; other prefix lengths are in supporting materials.
CTLS selector substitution does not change construction cost; reuse amortization is identical to the baseline write path.
